backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.blurb: You devoted yourself to service in a temple, learning rites and dogma.
backgrounds.featNote: Magic Initiate (Cleric): 2 cleric cantrips + 1 first-level cleric spell (1/Long Rest).

backgrounds.name: Artisan
backgrounds.blurb: You spent years learning a craft, gaining expertise with tools of the trade.
backgrounds.featNote: Crafter: You begin with two extra healing potions and a knack for quick repairs.

backgrounds.name: Charlatan
backgrounds.blurb: You learned to read people and lie with a smile — a silver tongue is a weapon.
backgrounds.featNote: Skilled: Gain proficiency in two additional skills of your choice.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.blurb: You lived a life of burglary and quiet footsteps in the city's underbelly.

backgrounds.name: Entertainer
backgrounds.blurb: You performed for crowds — songs, acrobatics, and glittering showmanship.
backgrounds.featNote: Musician: Heroic Inspiration — reroll one d20 per Short Rest.

backgrounds.name: Farmer
backgrounds.blurb: You worked the land, tougher than the soil and sturdier than the storms.

backgrounds.name: Guard
backgrounds.blurb: You watched city walls and tavern doors, ever alert for trouble.

backgrounds.name: Guide
backgrounds.blurb: You led travelers through wild places, reading land and weather alike.
backgrounds.featNote: Magic Initiate (Druid): 2 druid cantrips + 1 first-level druid spell (1/Long Rest).

backgrounds.name: Hermit
backgrounds.blurb: You lived apart from society, seeking wisdom in solitude and study.
backgrounds.featNote: Healer: Use Healer's Kits (start with 3) to mend wounds: heal 1d4 + 2 + level.

backgrounds.name: Merchant
backgrounds.blurb: You traded goods along lonely roads, weighing every word like coin.
backgrounds.featNote: Lucky: Reroll a d20 twice per Short Rest.

backgrounds.name: Noble
backgrounds.blurb: Raised in halls of privilege, you carry a name that opens doors — or closes them.
backgrounds.featNote: Skilled: Gain proficiency in two additional skills of your choice.

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.blurb: You spent decades among books and scrolls, unlocking lore's deepest secrets.
backgrounds.featNote: Magic Initiate (Wizard): 2 wizard cantrips + 1 first-level wizard spell (1/Long Rest).

backgrounds.name: Sailor
backgrounds.blurb: You worked rigging and decks on long voyages, thriving on salt and brawls.
backgrounds.featNote: Tavern Brawler: Reroll 1s on unarmed damage; on a hit, shove the target 5 ft.

backgrounds.name: Scribe
backgrounds.blurb: You copied documents and found the truth hidden between their lines.
backgrounds.featNote: Skilled: Gain proficiency in two additional skills of your choice.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.blurb: Trained in a militia or army, you know discipline, ranks, and warfare.
backgrounds.featNote: Savage Attacker: Once per turn, reroll weapon damage dice and use the higher total.

backgrounds.name: Wayfarer
backgrounds.blurb: You survived the streets or the wilds alone, trusting luck and sharp eyes.
backgrounds.featNote: Lucky: Reroll a d20 twice per Short Rest.

healer.name: Healer
healer.desc: Action: use a Healer's Kit to heal 1d4 + 2 + level HP.
